# Redshift DDL \u2014 generated by the OPF swarm

This directory is **populated by Worker A** during the migration run.

Expected output (one file per legacy DDL, see SPEC):

- `customer_dim.sql` \u2014 Redshift translation of `legacy/ddl/customer_dim.sql`
- `sales_fact.sql` \u2014 Redshift translation of `legacy/ddl/sales_fact.sql`

Each file must end with zero `sqlfluff` errors when linted with the `redshift` dialect (see SPEC for exact command).
